description: This file provides utility functions for handling HTTP responses and parsing query parameters related to pagination in a Node.js/Express application.

methods.name: parsePagination
methods.description: Parses pagination parameters ('page' and 'limit') from a query object, computing 'page', 'limit', and 'skip' values for database queries.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Sends a successful JSON response with a standardized envelope, including optional metadata.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sends an error JSON response with a standardized envelope, including an error message and optional details.

methods.name: asyncHandler
methods.description: Wraps an asynchronous route handler to automatically catch errors and forward them to Express's error handling middleware.
